inputs.name: GithubConnectionController.constructor.options
inputs.description: The required constructor configuration contains an origin string, a sessions service, and a GitHub connection or null. The origin is used for callback redirects, and a null connection makes status report GitHub as unconfigured while GitHub-dependent actions call authFail with github-disabled.

outputs.name: GithubConnectionController.routes
outputs.description: The value is an AuthRoutes map for GET /api/github/status, GET /api/github/connect, GET /api/github/callback, GET /api/github/repositories, and POST /api/github/disconnect; each entry accepts a Request and returns a Promise<Response>. No route returns a token or accepts an installation id.
